owner_execution.scope: Can the original equilibrium CAS11 forty-component orbital frame support explicit A2 roots1-9 per spin with complete48-state native vector/property data? The stretched channel rejection and the saved equilibrium active-space phase/position rejection motivate the missing same-model equilibrium channel control. This owner qualifies inputs only.

&input
  megul = 710, ! input from module CONGEN
  nfte = 810, ! Hamiltonian scratch file
/
&cinorn
  name = 'CO CI calculation - singlet A1',
  nstat = 5, ! number of CI eigenvalues
  nftw = 26,
  nciset = 1, ! index of calculated CI vectors within output file (0 = automatic indexing, but first must be 1)
  vecstore = 5,
  memp = 6.0,
  igh = -1, crite = 1e-12, maxiter = 1000,
/
